en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a large multi-story industrial brick factory building with many evenly spaced windows. The facade bears a long painted company name in German. In the foreground there is an unpaved road and piles of material, likely wood. The caption at the top right reads "Brand-Erbisdorf i. Sa." indicating the town, and the building inscription reads "Erzgebirgische Holzindustrie Act. Ges."
